title: Divaroside alleviates barium chloride-induced arrhythmia by activating the Nrf2/HO-1 axis to modulate autophagy and calcium homeostasis.
authors: Zhang, Chunge; Huang, Shuai; Zhang, Wenxin; Teng, Hongbo; Shao, Yuna; Zhang, Yihua; Ren, Shihang; Wu, Qi; Zhao, Yan; Yan, Zhaowei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物divaroside通过Nrf2/HO-1轴调节自噬和钙稳态缓解心律失常，属于纯药理学与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Acanthopanax sessiliflorus (A. sessiliflorus) extract has been used in various traditional Chinese medicines and compound preparations for the treatment of arrhythmia. Our preliminary studies have demonstrated that A. sessiliflorus extract exerts significant protective effects against arrhythmia induced by barium chloride. The present study aims to elucidate the bioactive components of A. sessiliflorus and to investigate the underlying mechanisms by which it mitigates barium chloride-induced arrhythmia. METHODS: Network pharmacology was employed to predict the pharmacological profiles of chemical constituents from A. sessiliflorus, followed by a systematic screening of their biological activities. Subsequently, a barium chloride-induced arrhythmia model was established, and the potential therapeutic mechanisms were analyzed using transcriptomics. Functional and histopathological analyses of the rat hearts were performed. Western blot was used to detect the expression levels of the Nrf2/HO-1 axis, connexins, ion channels, and autophagy-related proteins in myocardial tissue and NRVMs. Subsequently, PCR, immunofluorescence, co-immunoprecipitation, and molecular docking were employed to verify the involvement of the targets in the intervention of arrhythmia. RESULTS: The results showed that after treatment with divaroside, the arrhythmia and redox system imbalance induced by BaCl(2) in rats were significantly restored. Divaroside can inhibit calcium overload by regulating the expression levels of RyR2 and SERCA2a in the sarcoplasmic reticulum, serving as a means to alleviate arrhythmia. In addition, we have confirmed that autophagy plays a crucial role in arrhythmia, and divaroside can activate autophagy, thereby protecting cardiomyocytes from BaCl(2)-induced damage. Finally, it was confirmed that divaroside can weaken the interaction between the Keap1-Nrf2 complex and promote the nuclear translocation of Nrf2, activating the Nrf2/HO-1 axis and regulating the aforementioned pathways to counteract arrhythmia. CONCLUSION: This study suggests that divaroside prevents the occurrence of arrhythmia by activating autophagy and reducing abnormal calcium ion homeostasis through the Nrf2/HO-1 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：短梗五加（A. sessiliflorus）提取物已用于多种中药及复方制剂中，用于治疗心律失常。我们的初步研究表明，短梗五加提取物对氯化钡诱导的心律失常具有显著的保护作用。本研究旨在阐明短梗五加的活性成分，并探讨其缓解氯化钡诱导心律失常的潜在机制。方法：采用网络药理学预测短梗五加化学成分的药理特征，随后系统筛选其生物活性。接着，建立氯化钡诱导的心律失常模型，并利用转录组学分析潜在的治疗机制。对大鼠心脏进行功能和组织病理学分析。使用Western blot检测心肌组织和NRVMs中Nrf2/HO-1轴、连接蛋白、离子通道及自噬相关蛋白的表达水平。随后，采用PCR、免疫荧光、共免疫沉淀和分子对接验证靶点在心律失常干预中的参与。结果：结果显示，经divaroside处理后，BaCl(2)诱导的大鼠心律失常和氧化还原系统失衡显著恢复。Divaroside可通过调节肌浆网中RyR2和SERCA2a的表达水平抑制钙超载，作为缓解心律失常的手段。此外，我们已确认自噬在心律失常中发挥关键作用，且divaroside可激活自噬，从而保护心肌细胞免受BaCl(2)诱导的损伤。最后，证实divaroside能削弱Keap1-Nrf2复合物之间的相互作用，促进Nrf2核转位，激活Nrf2/HO-1轴，并调节上述通路以对抗心律失常。结论：本研究提示，divaroside通过Nrf2/HO-1轴激活自噬并减少异常钙离子稳态，从而预防心律失常的发生。
